title: group_join — output
description: Output schema for the SOX group_join operation. Confirms the agent's active membership in the group. Normative reference: spec/primitives/groups.md §5.3.

joined.description: True when the calling agent's status was successfully transitioned to 'active'.

group_id.description: The full group channel name, echoed from the input.

member_count.description: Current count of active members in the group after the join.
